text:
Oliver Park: Heads-up from Aurora Health AP: their renewal invoice shows a "Vendor Network Pass-Through" ($6,500) that they say should be billed by the vendor directly, not by Redwood. Also support tier looks prorated wrong. @MeiTan @RaviShah can you triage?

Mei Tan: Which invoice?

Oliver Park: INV-2027-0678 in the portal. Procurement attached PO hold note.

Support Billing Bot: Invoice INV-2027-0678 generated by billing-pipeline v3.5.8. Link: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2027-0678. Automated rule: unexpected pass-through SKU on private deployment account AURH-0099.

Ravi Shah: Pasted invoice lines from PDF: 
```
Invoice INV-2027-0678
Customer: Aurora Health Systems
Period: 2027-04-01 - 2027-04-30
 - Platform Fee (Private License): $28,000
 - Vendor Network Pass-Through: $6,500
 - Reserved Capacity: $72,000
 - Support (Enterprise Plus): $21,000
 - VAT (10%): $12,550
Total: $140,050
```

Mei Tan: Contract CNTR-1622 says Aurora contracted vendor connectivity directly and Redwood should only invoice our own services. The pass-through should not have appeared. Also Sales notes show Enterprise Plus effective 2027-04-10 (mid-month) so support should be prorated, not full month. Looks like two issues.

Support Billing Bot: Creating ticket BILL-10156: "errant vendor pass-through line + support prorate misapplied on INV-2027-0678".

Sales Lead: Procurement will not release PO until corrected invoice or a clear explanation is provided. They also asked whether VAT calculation is affected if we remove the pass-through. Tax Ops please weigh in.

Tax Ops: If the pass-through is removed, VAT base decreases. Current VAT $12,550 is 10% of net $125,500 (which includes the pass-through). Removing $6,500 reduces VAT by $650. Net impact = -$7,150. But confirm support prorate delta first.

Ravi Shah: Support: Enterprise Plus monthly $21,000; previous tier was Enterprise $16,000. Effective 4/10 means charge Enterprise for 9 days (4/1-4/9) and Enterprise Plus for 21 days (4/10-4/30). Correct support = (9/30)*16,000 + (21/30)*21,000 = 4,800 + 14,700 = 19,500. Pipeline charged full 21,000, so overcharged $1,500.

Mei Tan: So corrections are: remove pass-through $6,500, reduce support by $1,500 -> subtotal change $8,000. VAT reduces by $650. Total customer credit = $8,650.

Oliver Park: Procurement asked whether we can issue a credit memo and reissue invoice with a 30-day payment window to align with their AP. Also they requested a short neutral explanation for audit.

Support Billing Bot: BILL-10156 assigned to eng-billing. Suggested doc ids: CM-2027-115 (credit), INV-2027-0678R (reissued).

Ravi Shah: Opening billing ticket to prevent vendor_pass_through SKUs from being included unless tagged on the account. Also adding test to prorate support tiers using amendment effective dates.

Sales Lead: Legal prefers neutral wording. Draft to send to procurement: "We identified an inconsistency on invoice INV-2027-0678 and have issued credit memo CM-2027-115 for $8,650. A corrected invoice (INV-2027-0678R) has been posted to the portal with a 30-day payment window. We attached the amendment excerpt for your records. Please let us know if you need additional documentation."

Mei Tan: That reads fine. Include contact info for Sales and Finance.

Finance Ops: Preparing credit memo and reissued invoice. Confirm final numbers: credit $8,650; corrected invoice lines should be Platform $28,000, Reserved Capacity $72,000, Support (prorated): $19,500, VAT 10% on net $119,500 => $11,950. Corrected total $131,450. Apply CM-2027-115 => net due $122,800. Set payment terms 30 days.

Tax Ops: Confirm VAT calc: 10% of $119,500 = $11,950. Good.

Support Billing Bot: CM-2027-115 created for $8,650 (placeholder). BILL-10156 created: engineering assigned.

Finance Ops: CM-2027-115 posted; reissued invoice INV-2027-0678R uploaded to portal. Emailed procurement with neutral wording and AMND excerpt. Set 30-day terms. Journal entries queued for posting.

Ravi Shah: Eng billing PR opened to gate pass-through SKUs behind account flag and to fix support prorate logic. Ticket BILL-10156 updated.

Oliver Park: Procurement acknowledged receipt and approved PO release. Thanks everyone. Please confirm when journal entries are posted and then close thread.

Finance Ops: Journal entries posted, credit applied, revenue true-up completed. Marking thread resolved.

Support Billing Bot: INV-2027-0678 status: corrected (INV-2027-0678R). CM-2027-115 applied. BILL-10156 in progress.
